Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

 

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

 

  • Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment
  • Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories
  • Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance
  • Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness
  • Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models

 

Qualifications to succeed in this project:

 

  • Professional fluency in English
  • Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years  
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture
  • Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities
  • Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher)
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred)

 

Why join the project:

 

  • Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling
  • Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains
  • Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment
  • Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset.
  • Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance
  Qualification path

How to get started:

  • Complete your contributor profile and application

  • Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process
  • Acceptance form & Rater Academy: Complete an acceptance form and approximately 2.5 hours of Rater Academy training

Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Back-End

Front-End

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them.

We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone.

We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world.


What you'll do
  • Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way.
  • Write video scripts and outlines.
  • Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos.

What we're looking for
  • Native-level written and spoken English
  • Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently

  • Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects

  • A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise
  • Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload
  • Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada


Nice to have
  • Previous experience creating educational video content
  • Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about
  • Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos


Working at Metics Media

At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. Role Overview:

  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

What we’re looking for

  • Strong proficiency in React, Next.js, TypeScript/JavaScript.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS for production workloads.

  • Solid understanding of web security best practices (OWASP, secure storage, encryption in transit/at rest, secrets management).

  • Experience building systems in or adjacent to healthcare, education, or compliance-heavy environments is a plus.

  • Excellent async communication, code ownership, and ability to work with a small, senior-led team.

  • Comfort working from a clear product brief and also proposing improvements proactively.

  • Familiarity with logging, monitoring, and observability tools.

Take-home assignment (Step 1 of the process)

Please complete a take-home assignment. You are allowed to use LLMs to write code. To ensure that your work will not be used at Fluence, we’ve made it unrelated to healthcare:

Build “LendLoop”: a neighborhood tool-lending board with automated workflows

A simple app where neighbors list tools they are willing to lend, request to borrow from each other, and receive automated notifications and reminders handled by n8n.

Stack

  • Next.js (App Router)

  • Clerk for authentication

  • Convex for data + backend logic

  • n8n (self-hosted via Docker or n8n Cloud) for workflow automation

  • TypeScript

Requirements

Public page

  • The fictional company name is LendLoop.

  • Short tagline, e.g. “Borrow what you need. Lend what you don’t.”

  • Show:

  • A “Sign in to lend or borrow” button wired to Clerk.

Authenticated experience

  • Only signed-in users can:

  • List a tool with:

  • name

  • category (power tools, garden, kitchen, camping, etc.)

  • condition

  • short description

  • Request to borrow a tool for a date range.

  • Approve or decline requests on their own tools.

  • Mark a loan as returned.

  • Show:

  • All tools with availability status, filterable by category.

  • “My listings”, “My requests”, and “Incoming requests” views.

  • Nice, minimal layout.

Roles & rules

  • admin:

  • user:

    • Can create, edit, and delete only their own listings, and act only on requests involving their own tools or their own borrowing.

  • Implement the above role-based access control with best practices, enforced in Convex functions, not only in the UI.

Automation with n8n

  • Build at least two n8n workflows:

  • Request notification: when a borrow request is created or changes status, Convex calls an n8n Webhook. The workflow notifies the relevant user (email, Slack, Discord, or a logged mock notification is fine) using only the fields it needs.

  • Overdue reminders: a scheduled workflow runs daily, fetches overdue loans from a Convex HTTP endpoint, sends a reminder to each borrower, and writes the reminder status back to Convex.

  • Secure the integration in both directions:

  • Sign webhook payloads (e.g. HMAC with a shared secret) and verify signatures on the receiving side.

  • Keep secrets in environment variables and n8n credentials, never in code or exported workflow JSON.

  • Make write-backs idempotent so retries do not create duplicate records or reminders.

  • Handle failures with retries and an error workflow (or equivalent) so failed runs are visible and never fail silently.

  • (Bonus) Show recent automation activity on each loan in the app, e.g. “Reminder sent 2 days ago”.

Deliverables

  • A GitHub repository with the app source code.

  • Exported n8n workflow JSON files in the repository.

  • A README covering local setup (including n8n, e.g. a docker-compose file), environment variables, architecture, and your security and data-minimization decisions.

  • A short note on what you would change to run this in production.

We evaluate:

  • Security-minded thinking

  • UX and practicality

  • Integration design, reliability, and error handling (n8n)

  • Documentation and reasoning

Email your portfolio, GitHub repository, and as an optional bonus, 1-2 other relevant projects to techjobs@fluencetraining.com, along with a short note on a security/privacy consideration you implemented (or would implement) in a healthcare or similar context.

We are looking for a Principal AI Engineer to join the Practice Efficiency team at Doctolib.

Your mission will be to define and deliver how AI transforms the daily work of healthcare professionals — through intelligent scheduling, automated document processing, smart task management, and AI-assisted patient communication. As a Principal-level individual contributor, you will own the deepest technical challenges within the Practice Efficiency scope: setting the AI architecture bar, driving rigorous evaluation standards, and directly shaping how AI-powered features reach healthcare professionals and their patients at scale — starting with the Phone Assistant, currently one of Doctolib's most strategic product bets.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Own end-to-end AI architecture decisions for Practice Efficiency — from model selection and agentic system design to production deployment patterns,, and strategic build vs. buy calls

  • Architect and deliver agentic applications at scale, defining how Practice Efficiency AI features are structured, evaluated, and iterated on in production

  • Design robust, scalable AI infrastructure: model and prompt versioning, guardrails, uncertainty quantification, cost optimisation, and observability — enabling the team to ship reliably and fast

  • Lead the technical delivery of the Phone Assistant's AI capabilities, balancing ambitious product ambitions with engineering rigour and production reliability

  • Ensure responsible AI delivery in a regulated healthcare context, embedding explainability, GDPR/HDS compliance, and human-in-the-loop design across all Practice Efficiency AI features

  • Partner closely with Product Managers and cross-functional stakeholders to translate customer and business needs into sound technical decisions, acting as a bridge between engineering depth and product delivery

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Have 10+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years focused on building AI products — including experience building AI systems before the rise of large language models, giving you strong fundamentals in evaluation, data pipelines, and system design under uncertainty

  • Have a strong background in building and operating large-scale distributed systems — we value deep systems engineering expertise and will consider profiles who bring exceptional scale experience alongside a solid grounding in AI

  • Have hands-on experience designing and shipping agentic applications, with a clear understanding of the challenges around reliability, observability, and evaluation in production agentic systems

  • Are product-centric by nature: you have worked closely with Product Managers and product organisations, bring genuine business sense and customer closeness, and see yourself as part of the product delivery chain — not just the technical one

  • Are fluent in English

It would be fantastic if you:

  • Have built AI products in healthcare, financial services, or another regulated domain where safety and auditability are non-negotiable

  • Have contributed to or built shared AI platforms used by multiple product teams

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

  • Our stack in this product area is Ruby on Rails and TypeScript/React in the monolith, Kotlin for new services, with Postgres, Redis and Kafka underneath.

We welcome everyone

We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people.

About the Role:

The Dealer Development Manager will represent Upgrade Inc (Auto Finance Division) and promote our indirect lending programs. They will develop, maintain, and grow business partnerships between Upgrade Inc. and our dealership partners. The Dealer Development Manager is also responsible for staying up-to-date on local market conditions and industry trends. In this role, you will work with internal partners to find solutions that better serve our customers, and build long lasting relationships with key decision makers to drive growth and continuous improvement. This position requires residency in Dallas/Fort Worth, TX.

What You’ll Do:

Dealer Relationship Management

  • Develop and maintain relationships with new and existing dealer partners
  • Act as a trusted advisor to dealership owners, GMs, and F&I managers
  • Conduct regular in-person dealership visits based on a structured drive schedule
  • Deliver consistent follow-up and service to ensure dealer satisfaction and loyalty

Dealer Acquisition & Activation

  • Identify, onboard, and activate new dealer partners
  • Drive dealer sign-ups and first deals (“activation”)
  • Re-engage inactive dealers (e.g., no deals in 90 days) and return them to production
  • Execute onboarding training to ensure dealers understand programs and systems

Production & Volume Growth

  • Achieve monthly funding and application volume goals

Credit & Deal Structuring

  • Partner closely with underwriting/credit teams to structure deals effectively
  • Educate dealers on program guidelines, stips, and deal packaging

Portfolio Performance & Quality

  • Shift focus toward preferred collateral and higher-performing dealers
  • Ensure adherence to compliance, credit policies, and documentation standards

Training & Dealer Development

  • Educate dealers on value-added products
  • Provide market insights and best practices to improve dealer success
  • Position the company as a relationship-driven partner vs. transactional lender

Territory & Activity Management

  • Track and manage activity through CRM (e.g., Salesforce)
  • Analyze territory performance and adjust strategy based on data
  • Participate in team calls, sales meetings, and performance reviews

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a B2B Paid Media Senior Manager to our Marketing team in Brazil!

This role joins the Revenue Marketing team and focuses on our largest market, Brazil. You will lead our digital marketing initiatives across paid channels and use AI to increase demand generation, lead generation, awareness, and engagement for Wellhub. You will report to the Global Paid Media Director and work closely with the marketing, paid media, and creative teams. You will also manage end-to-end execution of ABM/hyper-targeted, awareness, lead gen, and full-funnel campaigns on LinkedIn, Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, and more. The role is hands-on: you will design campaigns, analyze performance, and optimize strategy. You will also build, motivate, and lead an in-house Paid Media team in Brazil. The work centers on high-priority strategic projects with visibility to senior leadership.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Own the Paid Media strategy for Brazil and its role in the overall marketing strategy, in partnership with regional marketing leadership.
  • Drive the region's targets (cost per MQL, CPA, ROAS, lead and MQL quality, MQL-to-SQL conversion, and B2B pipeline and revenue), focusing on profitable results at scale and on lead quality over volume.
  • Lead end-to-end campaign execution across Google and Microsoft Ads (Bing), paid social (Meta and LinkedIn), retargeting, display, and DV360 for SMB and Enterprise audiences.
  • Build retargeting and lookalike audiences from our HubSpot database, and connect ad platform data to the CRM so we can measure quality through MQL, SQL, and pipeline.
  • Run growth experiments, full-funnel B2B campaigns, attribution analysis, and A/B tests, including user-generated content ads and static ad testing on paid social.
  • Embed AI in daily work, from campaign analysis and audience discovery to creative testing, reporting automation, and forecasting. Claude is our primary tool, and you will use our AI Library and internal Paid Media tools. Design the tests that show when platform AI features (Performance Max, AI Max, Meta Advantage+, LinkedIn predictive audiences) beat manual setups.
  • Bring a strategic view that goes beyond what AI suggests: analyze results and propose hypotheses of your own.
  • Establish how the team uses AI responsibly (data privacy, brand safety, quality checks, human sign-off). Build AI-enabled workflows, prompts, and agents, and share them with other regions through the team's AI Library.
  • Lead, motivate, and develop the in-house team in Brazil. Coach them to build AI fluency and measure the gains in speed, efficiency, and performance.
  • Partner with marketing, creative, data analytics, and sales (including SDRs), and build trust with senior stakeholders. Report results, keep everyone aligned with the Regional Marketing team, and represent Paid Media in global and regional forums, including our bi-weekly global Paid Media meeting.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • This role is fully remote and open to candidates based in Brazil. All team members may join occasional in-person meetings or offsites, about once or twice per quarter.
  • A B2B paid media leader with at least 7 years of hands-on experience driving growth and strategy through paid channels.
  • A results-driven marketer with a proven record of managing budget and goals at scale, who looks past CPL and CPA to lead quality, MQL-to-SQL conversion, and pipeline.
  • A people leader with experience managing paid media team members and leading B2B paid media strategy.
  • A multi-channel B2B expert with proven success on Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, and LinkedIn, including audience segmentation.
  • Experienced with a CRM such as HubSpot, and aware of how tracking and conversion setup affect campaign optimization.
  • A curious, test-and-learn builder with hands-on experience using AI tools (such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini) and platform AI features, and the judgment to know when to trust AI output and when to check it.
  • An analytical thinker with strong skills in Google Sheets or Excel (models, forecasts, pivot tables) and BI tools such as Tableau or Looker Studio.
  • A self-starter with a strong sense of ownership who solves problems and works well both independently and in a team in a fast-growing company, across time zones (UK, Brazil, US, Argentina).
  • A confident communicator with advanced English (written and spoken) and presentation skills. English is mandatory, as our global team works in English.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in B2B paid media (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, LinkedIn), advanced English, and experience managing paid media teams are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

The role

We’re looking for a GPU Compute Partnerships & Commercial Operations Manager to secure and manage the external GPU capacity that enables our inference business to serve customers and grow.

Working closely with GTM, technical, and finance teams, you’ll translate commercial demand into provider sourcing priorities, help secure commercially attractive capacity, and manage provider agreements throughout their lifecycle. Your work will help ensure that capacity availability, deployment timelines, and provider economics support customer commitments and business objectives.

You’ll own day-to-day commercial and operational coordination with compute providers — from evaluating proposals and progressing agreements to managing capacity changes, validating service delivery, and ensuring accurate billing.

You’re welcome to work remotely from the United States.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Align compute supply with commercial demand: Work with GTM and technical teams to understand expected customer demand, deployment requirements, and timing, and translate these into external capacity sourcing priorities.
  • Source and evaluate compute partners: Identify and assess GPU providers based on pricing, available capacity, deployment timelines, service reliability, and suitability for customer inference workloads.
  • Support commercial negotiations: Compare proposals and help negotiate rates, capacity commitments, payment terms, service levels, and remedies that support the economics and delivery requirements of the inference business.
  • Drive agreements to execution: Coordinate Legal, Finance, Procurement, Security, and technical stakeholders through review, approval, signature, provider onboarding, and purchase order creation, keeping timelines aligned with planned deployments and customer commitments.
  • Manage ongoing compute partnerships: Serve as a primary commercial and operational contact for providers, coordinating capacity changes, service escalations, renewals, and contractual follow-through as business needs evolve.
  • Reconcile provider performance: Review monthly availability and SLA reports against contractual commitments and internal monitoring data. Work with providers and technical teams to resolve discrepancies and capture applicable service credits.
  • Manage billing accuracy and commercial adjustments: Validate charges against agreed rates, billable capacity, service periods, and delivered service. Resolve billing disputes and ensure contractual credits and adjustments are reflected.
  • Coordinate timely payments: Work with Finance and Accounts Payable to ensure approved invoices are paid on time and outstanding issues are resolved, supporting continuity of critical capacity relationships.
  • Maintain visibility into capacity and commitments: Track contracted capacity, spend, payment schedules, renewal dates, notice periods, provider performance, and open issues to inform commercial planning and upcoming capacity decisions.

  • Experience in infrastructure partnerships, commercial operations, technology sourcing, or vendor management supporting a commercial business.
  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to connect capacity availability, provider terms, and service performance to customer delivery and business economics.

  • Strong project management and communication skills, with the ability to drive progress across teams without direct authority.
  • Comfort with infrastructure concepts and translating technical requirements into commercial and operational actions.

Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal.

We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people.

About the Role:

An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human.

We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. Containment, CSAT, transfer quality and hallucination rate are your metrics.

Within your first year, you will own a portfolio of journeys across products (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, HELOC, Deposits) and help set the standards for how Upgrade builds, tests and ships AI experiences.

• Edge case handling: Map the unhappy paths (failed payments, mismatched identity, delinquent accounts, unsupported requests) and make sure each ends in a correct answer or a clean handoff

• Containment: Own containment and CSAT targets per journey, run staged rollouts (1% → 100%), and prioritize the work that moves those numbers most

• Product partnership: Work with product groups (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, Deposits) to scope new journeys, keep journeys current as products change, and define the APIs the agent needs

• Safety and compliance: Apply tiered authentication and step-up verification, verbatim compliance language and guardrails against hallucination and off-policy answers

• Handoffs: Design transfers to human agents in Genesys with accurate summaries and auth context

• Testing: Build simulation and regression suites so every journey change ships with evidence it did not break existing behavior

• Monitoring: Watch latency, errors and drop-offs in SumoLogic and Grafana, and own the alerts

• Voice tuning: Latency, filler phrases, interruptions, personality and tone

• Sierra relationship: Be the technical owner on our side, escalate platform issues and shape roadmap asks

What We Look For:

• 3–5 years of Frontend Software Engineering experience, or equivalent experience in Solutions Engineering, Conversational AI or Technical Product roles

• Working knowledge of how LLM agents behave: instructions, tool calls, knowledge retrieval, and where each one fails

• Experience building evaluations for non-deterministic systems: test sets, simulations, LLM-as-judge, regression gates

• Enough technical depth to read API specs, work with backend engineers on REST and GraphQL integrations, and reason about authorization and permission scopes

• Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain coded journeys and integrate APIs within conversational AI platforms.

• Product and customer mindset: you understand ops procedures, you read transcripts, care about tone, and measure success by whether the customer's problem got solved

• Ownership in production: rollouts, monitoring, log analysis and incident response

• Clear writing and the ability to work with non-engineers in operations, compliance and legal

Nice To Have:

• Hands-on experience with Sierra Agent Studio, or a comparable no-code agent platform (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect)

• Voice AI experience: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency tuning, barge-in handling

• Contact center systems such as Genesys, and agent handoff design

• Background in fintech or another regulated industry (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2)

• Conversation design or UX writing experience

What We Offer You:

• Competitive salary ($140K-$180K CAN) and stock option plan

• Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance

• Flexible PTO

• Opportunities for professional growth and development
• Paid parental leave

• Health & wellness initiatives

Environmental & Working Conditions

Work is performed indoors in a fast-paced environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established workflows, schedules, and service expectations.

Employees regularly input, retrieve, and exchange information accurately using digital systems and applications to support operational and customer service objectives.

Employees working remotely are responsible for maintaining a secure and productive workspace with reliable internet connectivity that supports company systems and safeguards the confidentiality of company and customer information.

Headquarters: Remote, Germany

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team:

Celonis grew up with the private sector: Deutsche Telekom, Mercedes-Benz, Uniper and three quarters of the DAX companies rely on Celonis Process Intelligence. Now we are taking the next big step in Germany: scaling our business with the public sector. To make this happen, Celonis is investing heavily through 2029 in its German public sector business.

Over the past year, we have built our Public Sector team from the ground up. Today, a strong go-to-market core team of Account Executives and Value Engineers is in place, working with federal and state-level institutions.

The Bundeswehr is one of our primary target organizations in the public sector. With our Celonis for Defense & Security initiative, presented at the Munich Security Conference 2026, we offer a sovereign and trusted platform that integrates data across systems and optimizes military processes along the entire value chain. This means higher operational readiness through optimized logistics and faster maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) cycles, greater resilience through end-to-end supply chain transparency, and faster IT modernization by connecting existing systems with modern AI applications. Building on our data analysis solution Metropolis, we also help connect information from a wide range of sources into a comprehensive situational picture, enabling faster and better-informed decisions during the actual mission.

To drive this forward, we are now complementing our existing Public Sector team with a highly specialized Account Executive who brings first-hand experience from inside the organization we serve: the Bundeswehr.

The Role:

This is not a typical Account Executive role. You bring the perspective of someone who knows the Bundeswehr from the inside: how its structures work, how processes in logistics, maintenance or procurement really run, and how decisions are made and budgets are approved. You will use this credibility to build trusted relationships across the Bundeswehr and the defense ecosystem, and to position Celonis as a long-term partner for its digital transformation.

Working closely with our Public Sector AEs, Value Engineers and product experts, you will translate the operational reality of the armed forces into compelling use cases, contribute to the creation of solution blueprints, drive opportunities from first conversation to signed contract, and help shape how Celonis enters and grows in this market.

The Work you'll do:

  • Build and own relationships across the Bundeswehr – Army (Heer), Navy (Marine), Air Force (Luftwaffe) and Cyber and Information Domain Service (CIR) – and its ecosystem, e.g. the Federal Ministry of Defence (BMVg), the Federal Office of Bundeswehr Equipment, Information Technology and In-Service Support (BAAINBw) and BWI GmbH.
  • Engage with decision-makers from leadership, logistics, procurement, IT and digitalization.
  • Translate operational challenges into concrete, AI-enabled use cases with measurable impact, e.g. in logistics and supply, MRO and materiel readiness, supply chain resilience, procurement and IT modernization.
  • Bring the voice of the Bundeswehr into Celonis: share insights with our product, marketing and value engineering teams to sharpen our offering.
  • Own an individual revenue target and drive complex, long sales cycles to a successful close.
  • Navigate defense procurement and tender processes (e.g. VSVgV, framework agreements) together with our partners and internal experts.
  • Work closely with partners such as consulting firms, system integrators and defense IT providers.
  • Represent Celonis at public sector and defense events and conferences.

The Qualifications you need:

  • Several years of professional experience within the Bundeswehr, e.g. as an officer or civilian employee, ideally in a leadership role and/or in logistics, procurement, IT, digitalization, planning or organizational development.
  • A solid network within the Bundeswehr and a deep understanding of its organization, decision-making and budget and planning processes (e.g. the procurement process CPM).
  • First-hand understanding of the process and data challenges in areas such as logistics, materiel readiness, maintenance or procurement.
  • A strong interest in moving into a commercial, customer-facing role. Prior experience in sales, business development or consulting is a plus, but not a must. We will support your onboarding into the sales role.
  • Strong affinity for technology, data and AI, and the ability to explain complex topics in a simple and convincing way.
  • Degree in Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program
  • Grit, a hands-on mindset, and the drive to build something new.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in German (native or fluent) and English.
  • Familiarity with defense procurement processes is a strong plus.
  • Willingness and eligibility to undergo a security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung) if required by our customers.
  • Ability to adapt to a fast-moving, high-growth environment and approach challenges with positivity, creative thinking and a growth mindset.
  • Willingness to be collaborative and inclusive, to embrace diversity, and strong interpersonal skills #differentmakesusbetter
  • Ability to leverage internal resources and work as a team #bestteamwins

#LI-SS6

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Headquarters: Remote, United States

      Category-defining tech. Career-defining work.

For more than a decade, Cockroach Labs has built database technology trusted to power some of the world's most mission-critical applications. Now, as AI transforms how software is created and operated, the infrastructure behind it has to keep pace. Cockroach Continuum is built to meet this moment, bringing individual databases together into one fleet designed for agentic applications, where AI agents help teams provision, scale, and optimize workloads at machine speed.  

The customers you'll work with are some of the most innovative businesses in the world, and the problems they're trying to solve are real and urgent. You'll bring a genuinely differentiated product to a market moving fast, at a company positioned to lead it. The people who thrive here are the ones who want to own that opportunity.  

The Role

We're looking for an Escalation Engineer to join the Cockroach Labs Technical Support team in the AMER region. You will be the escalation point for the most challenging customer issues: reviewing, assisting with, or taking over cases that need more expertise or oversight, and driving resolution with other departments. You are expected to work with a high level of autonomy and resolve complex issues quickly.

This is a remote role open to candidates in the Pacific or Mountain time zone, as the team operates in Pacific time zone hours.

You Will

  • Provide advanced support to customers and front-line technical support engineers to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex issues via CRM, Slack, video chat, and/or remote access.
  • Act as a point of escalation for tickets with no clear path to resolution where the Technical Support team has exhausted available tools and processes.
  • Identify when a ticket or account requires additional support and act proactively to course correct.
  • Use AI-assisted tooling in your investigations, including log and debug-bundle analysis, reproduction scaffolding, and code reading, and verify its output before it reaches a customer or an engineer.
  • Evaluate how escalations could have been avoided, and contribute to process, tooling, and observability improvements that reduce escalations and time to resolution, including where AI tooling could help.
  • Provide training and mentorship to junior support staff, sharing knowledge and expertise to help them handle complex issues more effectively.
  • Share effective AI workflows with the team, and help front-line engineers learn where AI output is reliable and where it needs independent verification.
  • Maintain detailed and accurate documentation of ongoing cases, including steps taken, findings, and proposed solutions.
  • Advocate for the customer within the organization, ensuring that their concerns are understood and addressed appropriately.
  • Participate in on-call and shift rotations with transfer of cases to other geographic regions in a “follow the sun” methodology.
  • Stay updated on new features, technologies, and best practices related to the products or services supported.

The Expectations

In your first 30 days, you'll learn CockroachDB, our customers, and our company through a self-guided onboarding platform of reading and hands-on exercises. By the end of the month, you'll be assisting customers directly.

After 3 months, you'll be fully integrated into the team and will be familiar with the various systems we use. You'll be able to manage most issues from customers and will be able to contribute to improving the scope and quality of our offerings. As our team and your expertise grow, you’ll begin mentoring and training new members of the team, developing and updating training and documentation to ensure that knowledge is not lost.

You Have

  • 7+ years of experience working in Technical Support or a similar technical role at a software company.
  • Strong knowledge of databases and the ability to read and write SQL.
  • Knowledge of distributed systems, Linux, and an understanding of software development.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, including root cause analysis, in a global 24x7x365 environment.
  • Experience using AI tools to troubleshoot and diagnose technical issues, an understanding of their common failure modes, and the judgment to verify their output before relying on it.
  • A customer-first approach to critical thinking.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including adjusting tone and content for technical and non-technical audiences, and a passion for working with users directly.
  • The polish expected when working with Fortune 500 enterprise customers.
  • Familiarity with, or willingness to learn, the technologies behind enterprise applications.
  • The ability to absorb information. You love getting into the weeds technically, but don't let that distract you from achieving your goals.
  • The ability to participate in a weekend on-call rotation.

Cockroach Labs has a hybrid work model, with Roachers that are local to one of our offices coming in on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays and working flexibly the rest of the week. Headquarters: Remote

Postscript is the AI-powered, all-in-one retention platform trusted by 20,000+ Shopify brands, including Brooklinen, Ruggable, True Classic, and Dr. Squatch.

Our mission is to maximize the lifetime value of every shopper. We built the best-in-class SMS platform, expanded into email, and launched revenue-driving AI products you won’t find anywhere else. Now we’re building the most AI-forward team in ecommerce, and we’re just getting started.

Backed by Greylock and Y Combinator. Fully remote since 2018.

As a Senior Software Engineer at Postscript, you'll be a high-ownership contributor to one of our core product or platform teams — owning meaningful systems end-to-end, driving technical quality, and helping shape how we build across the organization. Our engineering teams operate at the intersection of scale and product velocity, which means you'll be working on distributed systems that matter to the business while also influencing the technical standards that allow Postscript to grow sustainably.

This is a high-autonomy role for engineers who are energized by ambiguity, take genuine ownership of their work, and bring a strong point of view on how to build things well — without sacrificing speed or pragmatism. AI isn't a nice-to-have here — it's central to how we work. We expect our engineers to be active practitioners of AI-first development: fluent with the latest agentic coding tools, curious about what's emerging, and constantly pushing the boundary of what's possible with AI in their day-to-day craft. If you're the kind of engineer who's already experimenting with new models and tooling before anyone asks you to, you'll feel at home here.

As a senior engineer at Postscript, you’ll no longer be only writing code but orchestrating it.

This position is fully remote and can be based in the US or Canada.

Primary Duties

  • Take deep ownership of systems and product areas on your team — becoming the go-to technical expert for what you own
  • Independently investigate, design, and execute solutions across distributed systems with a high degree of ambiguity
  • Architect, build, and maintain highly available, scalable REST APIs and backend services for internal and external use
  • Drive system decoupling, modularization, and technical debt reduction — improving long-term maintainability without blocking near-term delivery
  • Build agentically as your default: leveraging concurrent autonomous agent workflows, owning the output, and keeping a steady queue of aligned work moving
  • Stay at the forefront of emerging AI tooling and practices, bringing new techniques back to the team and helping raise the floor for how Postscript engineers work
  • Contribute to how we think about integrating AI into our systems and workflows — not just using AI tools, but helping shape where and how AI creates leverage across the engineering org
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, data, and go-to-market teams — communicating clearly and proactively in an async-first environment
  • Identify and eliminate single points of failure, improving system resilience and knowledge redundancy across your team
  • Improve how engineering gets done: bring better tools, fix workflow friction, build internal utilities when the leverage compounds

What We'll Love About You

  • 6+ years of experience building large-scale backend systems and APIs
  • You are an active, daily user of AI coding tools and are using them to maximize your output — Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent — and can speak concretely to how they've changed your output and your workflow
  • Tech stack: Python, Go, React, and TypeScript; experience with Kubernetes, AWS, Datadog, and relational/NoSQL databases. You run agentic workflows autonomously and concurrently.
  • You follow the AI tooling landscape closely: new model releases, emerging agentic workflows, and evolving best practices aren't things you catch up on eventually — they're things you're tracking in real time
  • You think critically about AI output — you know where it accelerates you, where it introduces risk, and how to verify what it produces
  • You are able to context switch extremely quickly across concurrent workstreams
  • Experience working on both 0-to-1 initiatives and complex existing systems — and knowing how to balance building new things with improving what's there
  • Strong command of relational and NoSQL databases, SQL, and thoughtful database modeling
  • Familiarity building and observing applications on AWS, and ideally with Datadog or comparable observability tooling
  • Clear, direct communication — cross-functional partners and async teams can count on you to surface information proactively
  • Strong instincts for technical tradeoffs informed by both engineering best practices and business priorities

What You'll Love About Us

  • Salary range of USD $175,000–$220,000 base plus significant equity (we do not have geo-based salaries)
  • High growth startup — plenty of room for you to directly impact the company and grow your career
  • Work from home (or wherever in US / Canada)
  • Fun — we're passionate and enjoy what we do
  • Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Health, dental, vision insurance

For information about how we use your personal data, please see our U.S. Job Applicant Privacy Notice

You are welcome here. Postscript is an ever-evolving place of equal employment for talented individuals.

Headquarters: Remote, Germany

  Category-defining tech. Career-defining work.

For more than a decade, Cockroach Labs has built database technology trusted to power some of the world's most mission-critical applications. Now, as AI transforms how software is created and operated, the infrastructure behind it has to keep pace. Cockroach Continuum is built to meet this moment, bringing individual databases together into one fleet designed for agentic applications, where AI agents help teams provision, scale, and optimize workloads at machine speed.

The customers you'll work with are some of the most innovative businesses in the world, and the problems they're trying to solve are real and urgent. You'll bring a genuinely differentiated product to a market moving fast, at a company positioned to lead it. The people who thrive here are the ones who want to own that opportunity.  

The Role

Our Account Executives target and close new business with some of today’s most innovative companies. In this role, you’ll both nurture inbound leads in your territory with marketing-led support as well as prospect into a target list of select accounts. You will do this by driving opportunities through the entire sales cycle from pipeline generation to closure, employing a value-oriented sales methodology with a focus on use cases spanning customer data and marketing activation. The ideal candidate will have the aptitude and passion for becoming an expert in CockroachDB’s product capabilities, business impact, and competitive advantages and loves to build long-lasting relationships with customer needs at the center. While this is a remote role, you must be based in Germany to be eligible. 

You Will

  • Close new logos and expand existing business within an assigned territory, meeting and exceeding sales goals through prospecting, qualifying, managing, and closing sales opportunities 
  • Leverage and coordinate cross-functional internal teams (Sales Development, Legal, Engineering, Security, Marketing, Product) to efficiently navigate complex sales cycles
  • Maintain, build and own specific relationship maps for your territory, including existing relationships and aspirational contacts
  • Lead compelling presentations of CockroachDB’s product and vision to a broad range of audiences, from c-level executives to individual contributors
  • Provide timely and accurate forecasts and clear visibility on sales and revenue performance by actively handling your pipeline of opportunities

The Expectations

In your first 30 days, you will learn about CockroachDB and will be able to pitch the product proficiently. We believe that it is necessary for you to build this foundation so you can successfully engage with existing accounts and grasp the sales strategy. Upon completion of your first month, you will have built cross-functional relationships and will have started building your strategy for account penetration. 

After three months, you'll have a sound plan for account strategy and mapping. You have started building relationships with several leaders across your region and are beginning to understand their challenges and how CockroachDB can help solve them. 

After six months, you will have 3x your quota in pipeline and will have at least 3 POCs in process.  

You Have

  • 6-8+ years of experience selling enterprise solutions and demonstrated success in software sales within the database ecosystem or adjacent technologies
  • Experience leading large and complex sales cycles within the C-Level at Fortune 500 companies 
  • A consultative and value-based approach to selling software for cloud, on-premise and hybrid deployments
  • The ability to assess customer needs and build valuable, trusted relationships at all levels 
  • A track record of overachievement and hitting sales targets
  • Expert time management and resource skills

Cockroach Labs is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please email us at accessibility@cockroachlabs.com.

Cockroach Labs has a hybrid work model, with Roachers that are local to one of our offices coming in on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays and working flexibly the rest of the week. While we’ve learned valuable lessons working remotely, nothing can replace the connection, creativity, and fun that occurs when Roachers get together and we are committed to fostering a workplace that encourages collaboration and allows us all to do our best work.

  • Stock Options

  • Professional Development Funds
  • Flexible Time Off
  • Paid Holidays
  • Paid Sick Days

  • Retirement Benefits
  • Mental Wellbeing Benefits
  • And more!
